current_task: Trim redundant job_updated WebSocket broadcasts during active progress heartbeat

last_committed_milestone.title: Trim redundant job_updated WebSocket broadcasts during active progress heartbeat
notes: Added support for a `skip_job_updated` parameter to the `update_job` function signature.
Popped this parameter from the updates dictionary to avoid writing it to `state.json` and added it to the listener payload.
Integrated `skip_job_updated` guard in `broadcast_job_updated` to skip the redundant `job_updated` broadcast when set, while keeping `studio_job_event` for active progress.
Passed `skip_job_updated=True` in `OrchestratorHelpersMixin._publish` for active job status/progress updates, reducing active progress websocket chatter by 50%.
Added TDD backend tests verifying behavior and confirmed no regressions on the full pytest suite (847 passed).

active_constraints: Use Memory/rules.md as the shared source of truth for Codex and Antigravity/Gemini session behavior.
Use .agent/rules.md and .agent/rules/* for repo-persistent normative guidance.
Codex is lead architect, reviewer, integrator, verifier, checkpoint owner, and manual-QA caller.
Use Antigravity/Gemini for bounded non-trivial worker tasks; Codex must verify and checkpoint coherent results locally.
Use JSON-style prompts for Antigravity/Gemini handoffs.
Preserve the human-readable frontend, backend, test, and plugin folder structure documented in .agent/rules/modular_architecture.md.
Keep diffs tightly scoped; flag adjacent issues as follow-up work instead of silently expanding the patch.
For new behavior and bug fixes, follow red -> green -> refactor where practical.
Before handoff or commit, self-review the actual diff for correctness, edge cases, cleanup, type safety, accessibility, security, performance, and test quality.
Plugin metadata should remain canonical in plugins/*/manifest.json and plugins/*/settings_schema.json.
App-level behavior decisions should be plugin-behavior driven, not hardcoded to specific engine ids such as xtts or voxtral.

Main app code should not mention specific engine names; engine names belong only in plugins, plugin manifests/schemas, plugin-internal adapters, meaningful tests, or explicitly approved migration scripts.
Do not preserve legacy support or backwards compatibility for v1/beta behavior unless the user explicitly approves a specific exception.
Do not reintroduce USE_TTS_SERVER, USE_STUDIO_ORCHESTRATOR, or USE_V2_* runtime switches.
phase_11_guidance: Phase 11 audit entry point is plans/phase_11_audit.md.

Phase 11 core cleanup is closeout-ready: runtime fallbacks are removed, engine implementation is plugin-local, behavior is metadata-driven, frontend engine fallbacks are registry-driven, storage/output route exposure is hardened, and metrics/settings cleanup is complete or migration-only.
The voice registry fallback bug is fixed with is_engine_locally_available in app/engines/behavior.py and a permanent API regression test.
Remaining user-facing polish and manual app checks now belong to Phase 12, not Phase 11.
phase_12_guidance: Phase 12 item audit is complete. Verified complete: Library list/sort, Plugin dependency UX, Per-voice settings, Plugin boundary cleanup, Chapter Editor tab removal, VCR controls, Plugin ZIP import/delete, Queue output metadata, Legacy jobs API retirement.
Chapter Editor live queue selection now prefers the active job over stale completed chapter jobs so live progress and queued spans stay visible without waiting for a reload.

Chapter Editor progress no longer treats orphan active_segment_progress values as authoritative when active_segment_id is null; XTTS standard handler now suppresses pre-START_SEGMENT progress from active segment payloads.
Phase 12 product backlog items such as voice icons, searchable voice tags, and Hugging Face-compatible export bundles remain open for the final polish pass.
Chapter audio completion now recovers single-segment renders when stitching reports success but does not materialize the output WAV.
Queue history now persists and renders failure reasons instead of only showing a generic failed status.
Voxtral segment and bake rendering is still open, and default voice fallback should be audited because profiles are still drifting to Voxtral unexpectedly.
Chapter Editor now exposes a copy-debug-state button so the live progress contract can be handed over without relying on screenshots.

Websocket payloads now include source plus a classification field so queue chatter can be traced back to the emitting backend function or callsite and chapter jobs can be distinguished from segment-scoped child jobs.
Implementing the `check_output` interface in plugin adapters and completing the generic plugin setup loop in run.sh are the next high-value cleanup items.
Manual QA targets include engine settings test, project load time, chapter render enqueue, duplicate voice option warning, server shutdown, and mixed render retry.
Triage Vite websocket ECONNRESET and large-book project/chapter load timing.
Composite renaming (mixed.py -> composite.py) is explicitly deferred to Phase 13.
The TTS Server synth endpoint now allows synthesis while verification is still pending, but still blocks failed verification and setup errors.

Chapter Editor progress bar key is reverted to the segment-level key (`${job.id}:${active_segment_id}`) of commit 3e44973. This ensures the progress bar remounts per segment and progress/highlighting updates are aligned perfectly on a per-segment basis.

Chapter Editor progress bar now animates smoothly under finalizing status instead of hardcoding to 100% width. A 1500ms terminal job bridging window was added to useChapterStatus to let the green 100% Complete bar render fully before clean unmounting.
Global Queue now filters only true segment-scoped overlay jobs; grouped chapter jobs with active_segment_id stay visible so overall chapter progress does not disappear once rendering starts.
phase_13_guidance: Phase 13 owns release documentation, docs/demo assets, install validation, API docs, plugin author docs, release notes, and promotional materials.

codeql_context.current_policy: Defer CodeQL triage to the security verification track unless a finding directly blocks the current task.
codeql_context.local_annotations: codeql-annotations.json, if present, is informational and should not distract from Phase 12 polish unless intentionally used.

next_logical_steps: Implement the check_output interface in plugin adapters to improve engine-agnostic output verification.
Complete the generic plugin setup loop in run.sh so plugin install/setup automation is symmetrical.
Implement Voxtral segment and bake rendering for chapter jobs, then audit the default voice fallback that keeps drifting to Voxtral.
Prepare the voice icon and tagging implementation to improve large-library usability.
